title: simplify: the normal form of a term

normal_form.description: Canonical text of the normal form.

monomials.description: The normal form with its commuting dots gathered into monomials (docs/conventions.md, Printing), when that reads differently: a view of the same element, which parses back to it.

certified_by.description: 'computation' when the normal form is 0 and the computation alone proves the term zero (every step a relation of the presentation); 'certificate' when the normal form, in particular that it is not zero, also rests on the representation's certificate.
